RoleRadar

Job intelligence tool

A local-first job search tool that filters out noisy listings, scores the rest out of 100, and shows its reasoning for both. It drafts a cover letter for any role you pick, and never applies on your behalf.

  • Reason on every rejection
  • Five-part fit score
  • Drafts, never auto-apply
  • Runs on your machine
  1. GateStale, duplicate and empty listings dropped, with the reason
  2. RankSkill, seniority, location, domain and posting quality
  3. DraftA cover letter you review and send yourself
